spans.s: (Pāṇ. iii, 1, 97, Kāś.) to be sung, being sung or praised in song, Lāṭy.; Hariv.; Pāṇ. iii, 4, 68; BhP. x
a song, singing, MBh.; R.; Megh. &c. (said of the flies' humming, Pañcat. i, 15, 8/9)
गेय—ज्ञ mfn. skilful in song, VarBṛS.
गेय—पद n. a song sung before any one with the lute, Sāh. vi, 212.
गेय—राजन् m. ‘king of songs’, N. of a Cakra-vartin, Buddh.; L.
